title: Intertek — Breathability: MVTR and Ret testing standards
claims: Fabric breathability is quantified through Moisture Vapor Transmission Rate (MVTR) or Evaporative Resistance (Ret); the key international standards listed are ASTM E96, ISO 11092 and JIS L 1099.

MVTR tests report the weight of moisture passing through one square metre of fabric over 24 hours (g/m2/24h); a higher MVTR or a lower Ret value indicates a more breathable material capable of supporting intense aerobic activity.
If vapor cannot escape, sweat trapped against the skin leads to overheating in warm conditions or post-exercise chill in cold climates.
